about_the_game:
Dive into the quiet world of Tsukinoma and get a taste of Letty's journey in this exclusive demo.

You'll meet Letty, the curious letter carrier, after midnight when the peaceful solitude of the village is at its strongest. She’s the only one traversing this magical, hand-drawn night world, but she urgently needs your help.

Your joint adventure begins. Explore a section of the forest clearing and the village itself while Letty shares charming anecdotes from life in Tsukinoma. Your task in the demo is to decipher three letter puzzles. Solve the simple, visual picture clues on the letters to locate the drop-off points ("dead mailboxes") and finally deliver the post.

A Look Ahead: Your feedback is incredibly important to us! Although the unique art style is already eye-catching, we are currently working on further visual adjustments. Our small team is continuously working to finish Letty's story and release the full game in November.

We can't wait to welcome you to Tsukinoma - let's deliver that first letter together!
